note: Canonical English for the School Rewards portal. The portal is served from the school's own Apps Script project and cannot call the app's translation function, so its strings live here and are published as per-language packs. Keys follow the repository convention (slug + FNV-1a hash) so this namespace can be merged into ui_strings.js unchanged.

strings.a_cashier_verifies_the_live_balance_and_: A cashier verifies the live balance and completes the order.
strings.a_reservation_sets_quoted_points_aside_w: A reservation sets quoted points aside while the school prepares your approved print. Points are spent only when staff marks the item fulfilled.
strings.a_store_window_is_in_preview_or_open_1n2: A store window is in preview or open
strings.active_and_available_for_new_recognition: Active and available for new recognition
strings.active_and_visible_in_the_school_store_1: Active and visible in the school store
strings.active_student_who_can_earn_and_spend_po: Active student who can earn and spend points
strings.add_a_member_or_select_an_existing_accou: Add a member or select an existing account to change its role or active status. A managed email is locked while editing so a role change cannot create a second identity.
strings.add_a_student_or_select_an_existing_reco: Add a student or select an existing record to edit, deactivate, or reactivate it. Inactive students remain in historical activity but cannot receive awards or shop.
strings.add_an_exact_quantity_to_the_current_fin: Add an exact quantity to the current finite remaining total. It cannot exceed the saved limit.
strings.approve_appropriate_submissions_reject_w: Approve appropriate submissions, reject with a student-facing reason, investigate reports, or unpublish an approved entry.
strings.asset_verification_and_publication_are_s: Asset verification and publication are separate. A verified model remains private unless you explicitly request catalog publication and staff approves it.
strings.at_least_one_staff_member_can_award_poin: At least one staff member can award points
strings.award_the_same_recognition_to_several_st: Award the same recognition to several students
strings.checkout_refreshes_the_live_ledger_inven: Checkout refreshes the live ledger, inventory, and shopping window before showing the final confirmation. The cart stays in place if availability changes.
strings.choose_a_howl_or_school_defined_category: Choose a HOWL or school-defined category, then tell the student specifically what they did.
strings.choose_a_print_lab_handoff_package_1qt3n: Choose a Print Lab handoff package.
strings.choose_a_saved_prize_to_see_its_live_inv: Choose a saved prize to see its live inventory and version.
strings.choose_and_verify_a_student_before_check: Choose and verify a student before checkout.
strings.choose_and_verify_the_intended_student_1: Choose and verify the intended student.
strings.choose_and_verify_the_student_at_the_reg: Choose and verify the student at the register.
strings.client_checks_are_advisory_verify_the_as: Client checks are advisory. Verify the asset hash, units, slicer preview, material, safety, and printer settings before quoting. Queue buttons update records only; this portal never sends commands to a printer.
strings.confirm_the_hash_and_approved_offline_in: Confirm the hash and approved offline inspection before verifying. File bytes and Drive locations are never exposed in this page.
strings.confirming_a_quote_reserves_points_if_st: Confirming a quote reserves points. If staff requests changes, choose that request in the submission form to preserve its revision history.
strings.connecting_to_the_school_owned_rewards_l: Connecting to the school-owned rewards ledger…
strings.consent_withdrawn_address_changed_or_map: Consent withdrawn, address changed, or mapping corrected
strings.create_a_prize_with_its_starting_invento: Create a prize with its starting inventory, or edit an existing prize's name, cost, description, image, and visibility. Existing inventory is never included in a metadata save.
strings.create_private_model_and_submit_request_: Create private model and submit request
strings.download_an_aggregate_csv_of_orders_refu: Download an aggregate CSV of orders, refunded points, outstanding balances, finite inventory, and audit-chain status. Student names and emails are excluded.
strings.each_student_gets_a_private_total_at_the: Each student gets a private total at their managed school address.
strings.edit_the_included_howl_starters_or_add_a: Edit the included HOWL starters or add a school-defined framework. Deactivating a category removes it from new awards while preserving past student growth and explanations.
strings.example_revised_the_bridge_design_after_: Example: Revised the bridge design after testing
strings.for_a_new_finite_prize_a_blank_starting_: For a new finite prize, a blank starting remaining value means the full stated limit. After creation, use the reviewed Inventory adjustment workflow.
strings.growth_levels_use_points_earned_in_each_: Growth levels use points earned in each category. Store purchases never lower these levels.
strings.happens_on_shopping_day_practise_first_a: Happens on shopping day. Practise first at the practice portal if you like.
strings.hide_it_until_the_school_has_a_reviewed_: Hide it until the school has a reviewed printer workflow. Existing print records stay in the ledger, and print endpoints keep their own role checks.
strings.i_choose_to_share_this_design_in_the_mod: I choose to share this design in the moderated school catalog under the selected reuse terms.
strings.in_alloflow_s_3d_print_lab_run_preflight: In AlloFlow's 3D Print Lab, run preflight and download a privacy-minimized
strings.json_snapshot_exported_through_a_distric: JSON snapshot exported through a district-approved process. Preview performs no writes; applying requires a separate confirmation. No vendor credentials or live SIS connection are used.
strings.no_active_prizes_have_been_published_yet: No active prizes have been published yet.
strings.no_recognition_recorded_yet_what_staff_w: No recognition recorded yet. What staff write will appear here.
strings.no_unresolved_or_confirmed_failed_delive: No unresolved or confirmed-failed delivery attempts.
strings.one_private_message_per_managed_student_: One private message per managed student address. Emails show only the total, timestamp, and store availability—not behavior reasons or rankings.
strings.only_staff_approved_designs_appear_here_: Only staff-approved designs appear here. Report anything that should be reviewed; remixing creates a private copy and is available only when the creator allowed school remixing.
strings.pending_and_unknown_attempts_must_be_ver: Pending and unknown attempts must be verified outside this portal before resolution. Notes must not contain names, addresses, or other personal information. Only a confirmed failed delivery can be retried.
strings.privacy_safe_operational_status_only_rec: Privacy-safe operational status only. Recipient names, addresses, message payloads, and raw provider errors are never shown here.
strings.publishing_is_optional_moderated_and_sep: Publishing is optional, moderated, and separate from buying a print. Your school email is never shown in the catalog.
strings.purpose_color_preference_or_other_contex: Purpose, color preference, or other context
strings.recent_school_store_orders_and_receipts_: Recent school store orders and receipts
strings.recognition_categories_will_appear_here_: Recognition categories will appear here after your school publishes them.
strings.reconcile_to_a_counted_remaining_total_x: Reconcile to a counted remaining total
strings.review_and_start_guardian_digest_run_11x: Review and start guardian digest run
strings.review_handoff_it_contains_no_student_ac: review handoff. It contains no student account identifier.
strings.run_the_read_only_repository_scan_before: Run the read-only repository scan before a store day and after any ambiguous request. Most findings require operator review; only a pending signed award, correction, checkout, refund, or catalog/inventory operation can be resumed here.
strings.school_authorization_and_guardian_consen: School authorization and guardian consent have been confirmed for an active connection.
strings.school_owned_pilot_repository_google_sig: School-owned pilot repository • Google sign-in controls access • The live ledger is authoritative at checkout
strings.send_one_privacy_minimized_progress_and_: Send one privacy-minimized progress and balance summary per active, consented guardian connection. Google mail quota and duplicate-period protection still apply.
strings.show_the_3d_print_lab_tab_to_students_an: Show the 3D Print Lab tab to students and staff
strings.someone_can_run_the_store_register_1m1rr: Someone can run the store register
strings.stock_changes_are_separate_reviewed_tran: Stock changes are separate, reviewed transactions. The saved inventory version prevents an older page from replacing newer checkout, refund, or administrator activity.
strings.students_receive_balances_by_email_this_: Students receive balances by email; this catalog can be previewed before trimester shopping opens.
strings.the_browser_checks_type_size_and_sha_256: The browser checks type, size, and SHA-256 before encrypted Google transport. Staff receive only a private asset record, never a public Drive link.
strings.the_first_award_has_been_recorded_cuzb7d: The first award has been recorded
strings.the_store_has_at_least_one_prize_1t9bkqv: The store has at least one prize
strings.this_report_contains_school_totals_and_s: This report contains school totals and status counts only—no names, emails, guardian mappings, award reasons, or model details.
strings.uploaded_model_bytes_stay_in_school_mana: uploaded model bytes stay in school-managed storage and are not exposed through this portal. Staff must verify the asset and slicer preview before approving a quote.
strings.use_only_a_verified_guardian_address_and: Use only a verified guardian address and document school authorization. Guardian digests contain positive summary totals and no award reasons, rankings, model files, or student login details. Disabling a connection requires a reason but does not require reaffirming withdrawn consent.
strings.use_the_same_trimester_record_as_it_move: use the same trimester record as it moves from PREVIEW to OPEN to CLOSED. Dates are enforced whenever status is OPEN, and making one window visible closes any older preview/open window.
strings.what_staff_wrote_when_they_recognised_yo: What staff wrote when they recognised you. The full history is under Progress & activity.
strings.worked_out_from_what_is_already_in_the_l: Worked out from what is already in the ledger; nothing to tick by hand. Each line says which card to use.
